labels.note: Without the cache flag, repeat calls merge already-merged rules again. That duplicates manage/all rules in rulesFor output.
With no per-field rules, matchesField always returns true, so the lazy filter returns the same rules. Only performance changes.
Same as dropping the check: every rule passes matchesField, so the filtered result is identical.
An invalid subject no longer throws. actionsFor quietly returns the 'all' actions instead.
Input validation removed, so a non-subject-type argument returns actions instead of raising an error.
Only the error message text changes.
When the subject is 'all', the same keys are added to the Set again, so the result is unchanged.
The else branch stores null for the event instead of deleting it. emit and on treat null the same as a missing entry.
